  1. ERP SKU management
    • - Update SKU

SKU update synchronization

API for updating individual Shoplinker SKUs.

get https://apiweb.shoplinker.co.kr/ShoplinkerApi/Product/OptionSendStock.php?iteminfo_url=XML_URL[URL-encoded]&type=TYPE_VALUE
  • type : 001 - update only the SKUs of products in product management
  • type : 002 - update only the SKUs of linked products in marketplace query/update
  • type : 003 - update all matching SKUs in product management and marketplace query/update

Request Parameters

No. Parameter Type Description Value range Remarks
1. Required customer_id string Customer code (Shoplinker registration code) Code issued by Shoplinker
ex) a0000001
2. Required stock_code string Option management code
3. stock_barcode string Option barcode
4. stock_name string Option title
5. Required stock_quantity integer Option quantity
6. stock_sale_price integer Option additional price
7. stock_supply_price integer Option supply price
8. stock_keyword string Option keywords
9. stock_supplier string Option supplier
10. stock_supplier integer Option safety stock

XML sample

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="euc-kr"?>
<Shoplinker>
	<ProductInfo>
		<StockInfo>
			<customer_id><![CDATA[a0001555]]></customer_id>
			<stock_code><![CDATA[abc123456]]></stock_code>
			<stock_name><![CDATA[색상/사이즈]]></stock_name>
			<stock_value><![CDATA[노랑/100]]></stock_value>
			<stock_quantity>10</stock_quantity>
			<stock_sale_price>1200</stock_sale_price>
			<stock_supply_price>1000</stock_supply_price>
			<stock_keyword><![CDATA[키워드]]></stock_keyword>
			<stock_supplier><![CDATA[p01234]]></stock_supplier>
			<stock_safety>12</stock_safety>
		</StockInfo>
	<ProductInfo>
</Shoplinker>

Response

No. Parameter Type Description Value range Remarks
1. result bool Result flag Allowed values
  1. - Success : true
  2. - Failure : false
2. product_id string Shoplinker product code Shoplinker product code
ex) prod0001213
3. message string Result message Success or failure message 
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="euc-kr" ?>
<Shoplinker>;
	<ResultMessage>
		<result>true</result>
		<product_id>P012545</product_id>
		<message>수정성공</message>
	</ResultMessage>
</Shoplinker>
